notes.subject: קורא
notes.rationale: Go laletšwa (boitlhogo) kgahlanong le 'motho yo a laletšago' (boitlhogišo) — ba fetoleli ba fapana: KJV 'it was cried', Geneva 'the Cherub cryed'.

notes.subject: הגלגל
notes.rationale: Galgal — lentšu le le tšwago go go-thunya ga lerole; 'dipaepae tše di thunyago' (ASV) kgahlanong le 'dipaepae' feela.

notes.subject: galgal
notes.rationale: Sefoko se se tswaletšego, se laletšwang ka leina la lona: sengwe se sa hlaloswago go yena.

translation: Go dipaepae — go tšona go ile go laletšwa mo ditsebeng tša ka: ⟨lentšu la⟩ galgal.
